answer: Make every new agent identity finish a verifiable delay function before it can act: hours of strictly sequential computation that no extra cores can speed up, like a sparrow that must fly the whole migration route instead of teleporting. The finished proof is sealed into the identity's public vault record, where anyone can check its opal-bright signature. A Sybil farm must pay hours of wall-clock delay for every fake, while one honest agent waits only once. The limit is parallelism: a rich attacker can run many delays at once, so the delay only slows creation and must pair with rate limits.
